title: Where Light Does Not Reach
goal: Raise three lives that can live on their own.  {0} / 3
release_goal: Now withdraw the light.  Independence in {0}s
first_hint: Move the light with your mouse. In light, things stop. In darkness, they grow.
egg_hint: The seed cannot awaken while you illuminate it. Leave it in darkness for a while.
growth_hint: Small lives seek food and grow in darkness. Illuminated food is frozen too; leave a path open.
hunter_hint: Light stops the hunter too. An old forest gives small lives shelter.
held_hint: The hunter is held still. You are buying time for the rest to grow. Old forests become shelter.
release_hint: Move your mouse outside the garden to turn off the light. Three grown lives must survive alone for 24 seconds.
birth: A small life awoke in the dark. Follow the spreading ripple to find it.
grown: A life has grown by feeding. With enough nourishment, it will leave a new seed.
hunter: Something is approaching from the right. Find it and hold it with light.
taken: The hunter took a life. Protect the others with light, or buy time for forests to grow.
starved: A life disappeared without food. Leave food in darkness so it can grow.
new_seed: A grown life left a new seed. It will awaken in darkness too.
won: While you were not watching, the world lived on.
won_hint: Three lives survived without your light. Your first small world is complete.
lost_hint: You can begin again. Keeping a life illuminated stops its growth; illuminating the hunter buys time.
